_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Find remote jobs open to a country...

description: Find remote jobs a person can be hired for from a country. Use it for "remote jobs I can get from Vietnam", "remote support jobs open to the Philippines" or "crypto jobs hiring in Brazil". Pass country (name or ISO code). Optional: family (software, data, design, product, marketing, sales, support, ops, finance, hr, assistant, other), type (full_time, part_time, contract, internship), niche (crypto, ai, startup, nonprofit, academia, government), keywords, only_open, limit (default 10, max 25). Returns jobs newest first with open ones before unclear ones: title, company, verdict (open or unclear) and a reason quoting the post, application link, posting date, family, type, niches, location, salary when posted, a page link and the source to credit. Jobs whose post rules the country out are never returned. Daily index of public company job boards and remote job feeds.

country.description: The country the user would work from, as a name or 2-letter ISO code, such as "Vietnam" or "VN".

family.description: Role family, only when the user named a kind of work.

keywords.description: Up to 5 words that must all appear in the job, such as "react typescript".

limit.description: How many jobs, 1 to 25. Defaults to 10.

niche.description: Only when the user asked for crypto/web3, AI, startup, nonprofit, academia or government jobs.

only_open.description: True to leave out unclear jobs and return only jobs whose post includes the country.

type.description: Job type, only when the user asked for one.

name: find_remote_jobs

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

title: Find remote jobs open to a country
